note: NEITHER value is adopted by this run -- CLAUDE.md §15-5 requires explicit human sign-off on the motion gate. This report exists to give that sign-off real evidence instead of a percentile heuristic. false_pass_rate = fraction of block-static chunks (block_disp_px < 1.0px) that still clear the gate (latent_disp > gate) -- i.e. treated as informative despite no real block motion; lower is better.
